[RTCT.4.1] **Contract lookup.** When a compile resolves a
dialect that includes the `realtime` extension, the compiler
must take the contract from exactly one place:

1. the contract file the invocation names, when it names one
   ([RCLI.1.9]);
2. otherwise `<dsdir>/<basename>.dsrt`, where `<dsdir>` is the
   directory containing the source file and `<basename>` is the
   source file's basename minus the `.ds` extension. Exact
   filename match only.

A source read from standard input has no `<dsdir>`, so it has a
contract only by (1). The compiler must not consult search paths
or environment variables, and must not fall back from (1) to (2):
a named contract that cannot be read is a usage error
([RCLI.3.1]).
